packager: scripts/package.py archive() uses tarfile.open(mode=w:gz) without selecting a fixed gzip header time. Tar entries alone use mtime=0.
sourceObservation: The installed gzip implementation uses time.time() when its header mtime is unspecified. Both actual archive headers contain nonzero timestamps.
conclusion: Fixed tar entry times do not establish reproducible archive bytes. Recreating an identical payload at a different header time would change its digest. No two-build reproducibility trial is claimed.
nextAcceptance: Preserve prior packager/archives, explicitly fix gzip header metadata, and independently compare two archives of identical controlled bytes created with different output paths/times. Preserve all payload files and required controls.
